lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgV3Zn crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with a unit cell containing 20 atoms—Mg2V6Zn2—distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows Mg centers with 12 V neighbors, while V adopts both 12-neighbor (Mg, V, Zn) and 10-neighbor (V, Zn) coordination environments; Zn centers have 10 V neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 20 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Mg and V polyhedra, as well as between V and Zn polyhedra.
